thread:
maya: FYI opened docs PR with migration guide + SDK snippet. failing docs CI on linkcheck + vale + spellcheck. can someone take a quick look?

docs-ci-bot: CI checks started for PR #2981 — linkcheck, spellcheck, vale, markdownlint, preview-site build.

maya: linkcheck error points at an internal anchor in migration.md: `#installing-on-prem` -> 404 in preview.

rob: pinging, I'll take linkcheck. is the anchor a section header rename?

maya: yes we renamed the header during editing; old anchor was `installing-onprem` and I updated some links but missed one reference in getting-started.md.

rob: ok. I'll patch the broken link in getting-started.md real quick.

ella: heads up vale also flagged passive voice in migration.md: `We recommend that you pin the model` -> rule PR-VOICE. it's a docs style rule.

maya: thanks. can we relax that vale rule for this line or reword? merging depends on it.

sam: rewording is better. propose: `Pin the model to a specific version to ensure stable inference results.`

maya: updated the line in my branch to that. pushed.

docs-ci-bot: spellcheck found `enviroment` in sdk/snippets.md: line 34. Suggested: `environment`.

maya: oh nice catch — that's from a copy-paste. I'll fix and push.

jason: quick question on timing: is this blocking the 1.6.0 docs release? we have a merge window at 17:00 PT.

maya: it's on the release branch plan. if CI clears we should merge before the window closes. otherwise we'll delay.

rob: I've opened a small fix PR in the branch (link, one-liner). ready for review.

ella: reminded: markdownlint flagged MD013 for a long line in migration.md code example; wrap to ~80 chars.

maya: updated the example to wrap and used a fenced code block. pushed.

docs-ci-bot: Retrying checks (after new commits). Running linkcheck, vale, spellcheck, markdownlint...

docs-ci-bot: linkcheck: all links OK. spellcheck: all issues resolved. markdownlint: MD013 resolved. vale: still failing — PR-VOICE in migration.md at paragraph 2.

rob: can you paste the flagged sentence?

maya: "We recommend pinning the model to avoid drift during serving." (vale says passive/weak phrasing).

sam: change to imperative like before: `Pin the model version to avoid drift during serving.`

maya: changed to that and pushed.

docs-ci-bot: vale: all checks passed. preview-site build succeeded.

jason: awesome. can someone approve so I can merge in the window?

rob: approved. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks @rob. @jason go ahead. I'll monitor post-deploy preview.

jason: merging now. /merge
deploy-bot: Merge queued. Running post-merge preview deploy.

deploy-bot: Preview deployed at https://deploy-preview-2981.docs.redwood.ai/ — please sanity check anchors for on-prem section.

maya: checked the preview link; anchor works, SDK snippet renders correctly, examples formatted. all good.

sam: one follow-up: can we add a tiny CI rule to catch anchor mismatches earlier? maybe a linkcheck job that asserts internal anchors exist in the same repo before merge.

rob: open a follow-up issue? I'll file one and tag eng-sre/ci for attention.

maya: filing issue now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/512 — thanks all for quick turnaround :rocket:
